_comment: Canned payloads for `node test/harness.js --offline`. `home_log` is /reports/api/home-log (the default incident view), `incident` is /feed/api/incident/<id> (drill-down), `feed`/`since` are the live call tail. Rows deliberately mix field shapes so src/pkjs/index.js's pick() candidate lists stay exercised: a backend rename should degrade to one blank sub-field, never a blank feed.

calls.transcript: Show me out with Utah plate on 800 North, one occupant.
Structure fire reported, heavy smoke showing from the rear.

calls.transcript_clean: Rollover on southbound I-15 near the Orem exit, lanes blocked.

calls.transcript_snippet: Checking the welfare of an occupant at the listed address.

incidents.summary: Reports of an unfamiliar vehicle idling on the block; officer checking the plate.
incidents.representative_excerpt: I'll be out with a silver sedan, 640 North.
Caller reports a garage door left open overnight on the north side.

incidents.summary: Two-vehicle collision at State and Center, one party complaining of neck pain.

incidents.representative_excerpt: Vehicle blocking the alley behind the strip mall.

calls.transcript: Dispatch, I'll be out with a silver sedan at 640 North 700 East.

calls.transcript_clean: Plate comes back clear, registered owner lives on the street.

calls.transcript: Contact made, owner was waiting on a ride. Clearing, no further.
